summary: Comprehensive production-ready implementation plan and architectural audit for Speak Dolphin. Covers an in-depth current-state codebase audit, 3 application variants (Website, Mobile App PWA, and Web App), 4 new African languages (Igbo, Swahili, Hausa, Lingala), pedagogical AI enhancements for children and adults, Lead Bank payment & glitch-resilience integration, security & privacy hardening, and an actionable 8-phase roadmap with a final Go/No-Go launch checklist.
